stem.text: Which diagram shows the electric field lines surrounding an isolated negative point charge?

A.alt: Field-line diagram with a circled minus sign at the centre and radial lines with arrowheads.

B.alt: Field-line diagram with a circled minus sign at the centre and radial lines with arrowheads.

C.alt: Concentric circular lines with arrowheads around a circled minus sign.

D.alt: Concentric circular lines with arrowheads around a circled minus sign.
